scope: Screen a newly surfaced open-source 3D authoring project for route-specific DXF/ACIS comparison value, DWG codec lineage, and evidence independence; refine the existing peer-admission checkpoint only.

method.kind: Public repository README, repository metadata, published package documentation, and local plan review
method.limitations: The new project's claims are from its mutable README and public repository page. No immutable source revision, dependency lock, vendored ACadRust patch, output, release artifact, source-generated sample, or native AutoCAD acceptance result was independently inspected or exercised. Repository metadata and README status are time-sensitive.

routes.name: obj2cad DXF authoring
routes.observed: The README advertises a Rust ASCII/binary R2018 DXF writer and calls DXF verified. It describes a parity harness that reads output through ezdxf and compares geometry and layer/color values with a source OBJ interpretation. The public page identifies the repository as pre-release and shows a small history, zero stars, and no listed GitHub release.
routes.planUse: Discovery-only, trigger-based writer differential candidate. Before any use, pin an immutable source/dependency set, inspect the actual writer route and license, build it, and compare output against independently declared expected values and a separate reader.
doesNotEstablish: native AutoCAD or other CAD-engine acceptance
DXF conformance beyond the exact route and profile exercised
producer-authored CAD semantics from a project-generated OBJ-to-DXF control

routes.name: obj2cad SAT/SAB authoring
routes.observed: The README advertises an ACIS SAT/SAB writer, generated examples for common analytic shapes, and readback through ezdxf and ACadRust. No writer source or test harness was audited and neither reader was run in this review.
routes.planUse: Candidate only for a pinned, exact-profile generated-carrier experiment. Separate owner/payload identity, raw carrier preservation, parsed records/topology, analytic expected geometry, and native application acceptance.
doesNotEstablish: complete ACIS grammar or arbitrary producer compatibility
independent semantic truth from a same-project authoring/readback pipeline
DWG AcDs extraction and source-entity-to-payload association
valid B-rep semantics from payload presence, entity count, or tessellation alone

routes.name: obj2cad DWG authoring
routes.observed: The README says the DWG crate vendors a patched ACadRust writer and marks DWG/curved-surface output beta until AutoCAD acceptance.
routes.planUse: Count only as the existing ACadRust DWG codec lineage. Do not treat the application as another independent DWG implementation or as evidence of AutoCAD acceptance.
doesNotEstablish: a second independent DWG reader/writer lineage
DWG support parity from the README's advertised version span
native CAD acceptance before the documented acceptance gate

readinessRefinement: Admit obj2cad only at the existing composed checkpoint and only for a concrete uncovered question; exact-pin its source, dependencies, and license before building.
Audit its vendored ACadRust revision and local patches; count its DWG route in the existing ACadRust lineage, not as an independent peer.
Evaluate DXF authoring and SAT/SAB authoring as separate routes. Use independent expectations/readers and distinguish carriers, graph association, semantics, and native acceptance.
If the route cannot be pinned or audited, record NOT_AVAILABLE and continue the local implementation queue; do not add routine tests, dependencies, or committed peer fixtures.
